items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis, a touch of awe on the space lines, and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy: first planet Earth as a proud, slightly offended tired mum, then a calm deadpan friendly alien planet at the end.
lines: Narrator
Earth's closest twin is just four point two light-years away.
Narrator
And we still can't visit. Not even close.
Narrator
Meet Proxima b. A rocky world, at least as heavy as Earth.
Narrator
It sits in its star's habitable zone, where water could stay liquid.
Chars
[offended, proud, a tired mum, dry] Twin? I was told I'm unique.
Narrator
So why not go? Even light needs four point two years.
Narrator
Voyager One, at sixty thousand kilometres an hour? About seventy-six thousand years.
Narrator
That's about six times longer than humans have been farming.
Narrator
And the trip isn't even the worst part.
Narrator
A year there lasts just eleven days. It hugs its star, about twenty times closer than we are to the Sun.
Narrator
So one side probably faces it forever. Endless day. Endless night.
Narrator
And its star throws tantrums. In twenty nineteen it flared fourteen thousand times brighter in ultraviolet, in seconds.
Narrator
So does it still have air? Nobody knows yet.
Narrator
Our closest twin might be half desert, half ice.
Chars
[deadpan, calm, friendly, slow] Visitors welcome. Bring sunscreen. And a jacket.
Narrator
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
